note: Ps59 Deliver-me-from-enemies (corrected; Saul watched his house). Human IB: enemies = evildoers, bloodthirsty (dam), lie-in-wait (arab), fierce (az), stir strife (gur), treacherous (bagad) + evil, presumptuous 'who will hear us' (brazen godlessness), sin/pride/cursing/lies of mouth; the psalmist's protested innocence (no transgression); the twin refrain response - 'I will WATCH for you' (shamar) + 'I will SING/sing-aloud/sing-praises' of God's strength+chesed; triumphant looking; the people's not-forgetting; that they may KNOW God rules. God-qualifiers=31 (deliver/protect/save/rouse/meet/see/punish/spare/kill-not/totter/consume; his mocking laugh+derision; his titles Strength/fortress/refuge/shield/chesed). Dog imagery (howling/prowling/growling) + swords-in-lips + superscription = standalone. Every candidate roled.

dims.v: evil / iniquity (aven - those who work evil)

'deliver me from those who work EVIL (aven)' — the workers of iniquity the psalmist flees; aven the wickedness that is the enemies' trade, joined to bloodthirst — the malice that watches his house to kill
bloodthirsty / men of blood (dam - save me from bloodthirsty men)
paired with the workers of evil
'save me from BLOODTHIRSTY (dam) men' — the murderous character of the foes; 'men of blood' (anshei damim) whose appetite is for killing — the lethal intent behind the watching and lying-in-wait
lie in wait / ambush (arab - they lie in wait for my life)
paired with the fierce men stirring strife
'For behold, they LIE IN WAIT (arab) for my life' — the predatory ambush; arab here the enemies lurking to seize his nefesh — the crouching menace that opens the psalm's alarm
life / soul (nefesh - they lie in wait for my life)
the life for which God is called to awake and see (v4)
'they lie in wait for my LIFE (nefesh)' — the psalmist's life, the prize of the ambush; nefesh here what the fierce men hunt, for which he calls God to awake, come, and see (v4, the qualifiers)
fierce / strong men (az - fierce men stir up strife)
paired with their stirring up strife
'FIERCE men (az) stir up strife against me' — the mighty, ruthless foes; az (strong/fierce) the powerful enemies who band against the psalmist, and that though he has done no wrong (v3-4)
stir up strife / band together (gur - stir up strife against me)
the act of the fierce men
'fierce men STIR UP STRIFE (gur) against me' — the massing of the foes; gur (to gather/attack) the enemies banding against him — organised hostility, not for any fault of his (cf Ps56:6)
transgression (pesha - for no transgression of mine)
none of his; a clear conscience
paired with the disavowed sin and fault

'For no TRANSGRESSION (pesha) or sin of mine, O LORD, for no fault of mine, they run and make ready' — the protestation of innocence; the psalmist's clear conscience, that the assault is wholly undeserved — his blamelessness the ground of his appeal, the opposite of the wicked's guilt
deal treacherously (bagad - those who treacherously plot evil)
paired with the evil they plot

'spare none of those who TREACHEROUSLY (bagad) plot evil' — the faithless, deceitful malice of the foes; bagad (to act treacherously/betray) the covenant-breaking wickedness that God is asked not to spare — treachery joined to evil design
'those who treacherously plot EVIL (aven)' — the iniquity the faithless design; aven the evil hatched by treachery, echoing the evil-workers of v2 — the wickedness God is roused to punish

'for Who, they think, will HEAR (shama) us?' — the brazen presumption of the wicked, that no one (not even God) marks their words; shama here the hearing they deny — practical atheism (cf the fool, Ps53), which God answers with derisive laughter (v8, the qualifier)
watch / keep watch (shamar - I will watch for you)
because God is his fortress who meets him in steadfast love (v9-10)

'O my Strength, I will WATCH (shamar) for you, for you, O God, are my fortress' — the turn from the watching enemies (v1 superscr) to the watching believer; shamar here the psalmist keeping watch FOR God as the enemies keep watch against him — expectant waiting on his Strength and fortress
look (in triumph) (raah - look on my enemies)
granted by the God who meets him in love

'God will let me LOOK (raah) in triumph on my enemies' — the vindicated gaze the delivered psalmist expects; raah here the confident looking on the defeat of the foes (cf Ps54:7) — not gloating but the assurance of God's steadfast love meeting him
the reason God is asked to make them totter rather than kill outright

'Kill them not, lest my people FORGET (shakach)' — a lingering judgment sought so the lesson endures; shakach here the forgetting to be prevented — the people must not lose sight of God's justice, so the wicked are made to totter as a standing warning rather than swept away at once
sin (chatta't - the sin of their mouths)
in the words of their lips
paired with their pride, cursing, and lies

'For the SIN (chatta't) of their mouths, the words of their lips' — the enemies' guilt located in their speech; chatta't here the sin of the mouth — the cursing and lies that condemn them, for which they are caught in their own pride
pride / arrogance (gaon - trapped in their pride)
the sin of their mouths and cursing

'let them be trapped in their PRIDE (gaon)' — the arrogance that becomes the snare; gaon (haughtiness) the self-exaltation of the wicked, so that their own pride ensnares them — caught by the very loftiness of their cursing speech, to be consumed in God's wrath (v13, the qualifier)
paired with the lies they utter

'For the CURSING (alah) and lies that they utter' — the imprecations of the wicked; alah (curse/oath) the cursing speech that pours from their mouths, joined to lies — the verbal sin that seals their guilt
lies / deceit (kachash - the lies they utter)
paired with the cursing they utter

'the cursing and LIES (kachash) that they utter' — the falsehood of the wicked's speech; kachash (lying/deception) the deceit twinned with cursing — the mouth's sin that, with their pride, brings God's consuming wrath
know / acknowledge (yada - that they may know that God rules)
that God rules over Jacob to the ends of the earth
the goal of the judgment on the proud

'that they may KNOW (yada) that God rules over Jacob to the ends of the earth' — the aim of judgment: recognition of God's reign; yada here the acknowledgment forced on the wicked — that the God they thought did not hear (v7) rules over all — knowledge as the fruit of judgment
sing (shir - I will sing of your strength)
paired with singing aloud of his steadfast love
because God has been his fortress and refuge in distress (v16)

'But I will SING (shir) of your strength; I will sing aloud of your steadfast love in the morning' — watching (v9) turns to morning song; shir here the praise that answers the night of the prowling dogs — the believer greets the dawn singing of the fortress that held him
sing aloud / ring out (ranan - I will sing aloud of your steadfast love)
paired with singing of his strength

'I will SING ALOUD (ranan) of your steadfast love in the morning' — jubilant praise of God's chesed; ranan here the ringing morning-song, celebrating the steadfast love that proved a refuge in the day of distress (v16, the qualifier)
sing praises (zamar - I will sing praises to you)
the refrain of v9 now fulfilled in praise
because God is his fortress, who shows him steadfast love (v17)

'O my Strength, I will SING PRAISES (zamar) to you, for you, O God, are my fortress, the God who shows me steadfast love' — the closing refrain, watching become praise; zamar here the song that seals the psalm, addressing God as Strength, fortress, and the God of chesed (v17, the qualifiers)
deliver / rescue (natsal - deliver me from my enemies)
God's deliverance the watching psalmist waits for (v1)
v1 QUALIFIER (God's act): 'DELIVER (natsal) me from my enemies, O my God' - God's rescue is not a human IB char; the deliverance the psalmist watches and waits for (280648). Qualifier.
set on high / protect (sagab - protect me)
God's protection the psalmist waits for (v1)
v1 QUALIFIER (God's act): 'PROTECT (sagab) me from those who rise up' - God's setting him on high is not a human IB char; the safety the watching believer counts on (280648). Qualifier.
deliver (natsal - deliver me from those who work evil)
v2 QUALIFIER (God's act): 'DELIVER (natsal) me from those who work evil' - God's rescue is not a human IB char; the deliverance the psalmist waits for (280648). Qualifier.
save (yasha - save me from bloodthirsty men)
v2 QUALIFIER (God's act): 'and SAVE (yasha) me from bloodthirsty men' - God's saving is not a human IB char; the deliverance the watching psalmist relies on (280648). Qualifier.
awake / rouse (ur - Awake, come to meet me)
God asked to awake to the psalmist's endangered life (v4)
v4 QUALIFIER (God's act asked): 'AWAKE (ur), come to meet me, and see!' - God's rousing is not a human IB char; the divine attention called to the life the enemies ambush (280603). Qualifier.
come to meet (qara - come to meet me)
God asked to come meet the psalmist in his peril (v4)
v4 QUALIFIER (God's act asked): 'come to MEET (qara) me' - God's coming is not a human IB char; the help summoned to the endangered life (280603). Qualifier.
God asked to see the psalmist's plight (v4)
v4 QUALIFIER (God's act asked): 'and SEE (raah)!' - God's beholding is not a human IB char; the divine notice called to the undeserved assault on his life (280603). Qualifier.
rouse oneself (quts - Rouse yourself to punish)
God asked to rouse himself against the treacherous (v5)

v5 QUALIFIER (God's act asked): 'ROUSE (quts) yourself to punish all the nations' - God's rousing is not a human IB char; the judgment called down on the treacherous plotters of evil (280630). Qualifier.
punish / visit (paqad - to punish all the nations)

v5 QUALIFIER (God's act, re-roled from an earlier mis-call): 'to PUNISH (paqad) all the nations' - God's visitation in judgment is not a human IB char; the punishment sought on the treacherous (280630). Qualifier.
be gracious / spare (chanan - spare none of the treacherous)
God asked to spare none of the treacherous (v5)

v5 QUALIFIER (God's act, negated): 'SPARE (chanan) none of those who treacherously plot evil' - God's sparing is not a human IB char; the mercy withheld from the treacherous (280630) in the imprecation. Qualifier.
laugh / deride (sachaq - you laugh at them)
God laughs at the enemies who think none hears (v8)

v8 QUALIFIER (God's act, re-roled from an earlier mis-call): 'But you, O LORD, LAUGH (sachaq) at them' - God's mockery is not a human IB char; his derision of the enemies who presumed none hears (280640) - the sovereign laughter of Ps2:4. Qualifier.
hold in derision (laag - you hold the nations in derision)
God holds the presuming nations in derision (v8)

v8 QUALIFIER (God's act): 'you hold all the nations in DERISION (laag)' - God's scorn is not a human IB char; twin of his laughter, mocking the enemies' presumption that none hears (280640). Qualifier.
God as the psalmist's strength, for whom he watches (v9)

v9 QUALIFIER (God as strength): 'O my STRENGTH (oz), I will watch for you' - God as the psalmist's strength is not a human IB char; the divine security the believer watches for (280648), the refrain-title (v9,16,17). Qualifier.
fortress / high stronghold (misgab - you are my fortress)
God as the psalmist's fortress, ground of his watching (v9)

v9 QUALIFIER (God as fortress): 'for you, O God, are my FORTRESS (misgab)' - God as stronghold is not a human IB char; the high refuge the psalmist watches for (280648), the recurring title. Qualifier.
steadfast love (chesed - in his steadfast love will meet me)
God's love the ground of the watching, moving him to meet the psalmist (v10)

v10 QUALIFIER (God's chesed): 'My God in his STEADFAST LOVE (chesed) will meet me' - God's covenant love is not a human IB char; the love that meets the watching psalmist (280648) and lets him look on his enemies. Qualifier.
meet / go before (qadam - will meet me)
God goes before / meets the watching psalmist (v10)
v10 QUALIFIER (God's act): 'my God in his steadfast love will MEET (qadam) me' - God's coming to meet him is not a human IB char; the encounter that rewards the watching (280648). Qualifier.
God asked NOT to kill them at once, lest the people forget (v11)

v11 QUALIFIER (God's act, negated): 'KILL (harag) them not, lest my people forget' - God's slaying is not a human IB char; the swift judgment withheld so the people not forget (280542) the lesson. Qualifier.
make totter / wander (nua - make them totter by your power)
God asked to make the proud enemies totter (v11)

v11 QUALIFIER (God's act): 'make them TOTTER (nua) by your power and bring them down' - God's unsettling of the enemies is not a human IB char; the measured judgment on the proud (280553), a wandering warning. Qualifier.
God's power that brings the proud enemies low (v11)
v11 QUALIFIER (God's power): 'make them totter by your POWER (chayil)' - God's might is not a human IB char; the strength that topples the proud (280553). Qualifier.
God as the people's shield, for whom the psalmist watches (v11)

v11 QUALIFIER (God as shield): 'bring them down, O Lord, our SHIELD (magen)' - God as the people's shield is not a human IB char; the protector-title, the security the psalmist watches for (280648). Qualifier.
consume / make an end (kalah - consume them in wrath)
God asked to consume the proud enemies in wrath (v13)
v13 QUALIFIER (God's act): 'CONSUME (kalah) them in wrath' - God's consuming judgment is not a human IB char; the end brought on the proud wicked (280553). Qualifier.
God's wrath that consumes the proud (v13)
v13 QUALIFIER (God's wrath): 'consume them in WRATH (chemah)' - God's anger is not a human IB char; the wrath that answers the pride and cursing of the wicked (280553). Qualifier.
consume / make an end (kalah - consume them till no more)
God consumes them so all may know he rules (v13)

v13 QUALIFIER (God's act, emphatic repeat): 'CONSUME (kalah) them till they are no more, that they may know that God rules' - God's finishing judgment is not a human IB char; its aim the knowledge that God reigns (280563). Qualifier.
rule / have dominion (mashal - God rules over Jacob)
God's rule, what the judgment makes known (v13)
v13 QUALIFIER (God's rule): 'that God RULES (mashal) over Jacob to the ends of the earth' - God's dominion is not a human IB char; the sovereignty the enemies are made to know (280563). Qualifier.
strength (oz - I will sing of your strength)
God's strength, the theme of the morning song (v16)
v16 QUALIFIER (God's strength): 'I will sing of your STRENGTH (oz)' - God's strength is not a human IB char; the subject of the psalmist's singing (280573). Qualifier.
steadfast love (chesed - sing aloud of your steadfast love)
God's love, the theme of the jubilant morning song (v16)

v16 QUALIFIER (God's chesed): 'I will sing aloud of your STEADFAST LOVE (chesed) in the morning' - God's covenant love is not a human IB char; the subject of the psalmist's ringing praise (280575). Qualifier.
fortress (misgab - you have been to me a fortress)
God has been his fortress, ground of the song (v16)
v16 QUALIFIER (God as fortress): 'For you have been to me a FORTRESS (misgab)' - God as stronghold is not a human IB char; the refuge that grounds the psalmist's morning song (280573). Qualifier.
refuge (manos - a refuge in the day of my distress)
God has been his refuge in distress, ground of the song (v16)
v16 QUALIFIER (God as refuge): 'and a REFUGE (manos) in the day of my distress' - God as place of escape is not a human IB char; the shelter that moves the psalmist to sing (280573). Qualifier.
strength (oz - O my Strength, I will sing praises)
God as the psalmist's strength, addressed in the closing praise (v17)
v17 QUALIFIER (God as strength): 'O my STRENGTH (oz), I will sing praises to you' - God as strength is not a human IB char; the addressee of the closing song (280585), the refrain-title. Qualifier.
fortress (misgab - you, O God, are my fortress)
God as fortress, ground of the closing praise (v17)
v17 QUALIFIER (God as fortress): 'for you, O God, are my FORTRESS (misgab)' - God as stronghold is not a human IB char; the ground of the psalmist's praise (280585), the closing refrain. Qualifier.
steadfast love (chesed - the God who shows me steadfast love)
God who shows him steadfast love, addressed in praise (v17)

v17 QUALIFIER (God's chesed): 'the God who shows me STEADFAST LOVE (chesed)' - God's covenant love is not a human IB char; the God the psalmist praises (280585), who has shown him love through the ordeal. Qualifier.
superscription: 'when Saul SENT (shalach) men and they watched the house in order to kill him' - the historical occasion; narrative framing in the heading. Standalone.
superscription: 'they WATCHED (shamar) the house to kill him' - the enemies' watching (ironically answered by the psalmist's 'I will watch for you', v9); part of the historical heading. Standalone.
kill / put to death (mut - in order to kill him)
superscription: 'to KILL (mut) him' - the enemies' lethal intent in the historical heading. Standalone.
rise up (qum - those who rise up against me)
v1: 'those who RISE UP (qum) against me' - the enemies' hostile rising; a bare act of the foes, whose malice is read in the evildoer/bloodthirsty chars (v2). Standalone (hostile rising).
work / practise (paal - those who work evil)
v2: 'those who WORK (paal) evil' - the doing; its substance, evil, is the char (280594). Standalone (the working).
sin (chatta't - for no sin of mine)

v3: 'for no transgression or SIN (chatta't) of mine' - the sin the psalmist disavows; part of the innocence-protestation, its content carried in the innocence char (280608). Standalone (disavowed sin).
fault / iniquity (avon - for no fault of mine)
v4: 'for no FAULT (avon) of mine, they run and make ready' - the fault the psalmist disavows; the third term of the innocence-protestation (280608). Standalone (disavowed fault).
run (rutz - they run and make ready)
v4: 'they RUN (rutz) and make ready' - the enemies rushing to attack; a bare hostile act, their malice read in the enemy-chars. Standalone (enemy act).
return / come back (shub - each evening they come back)
v6: 'Each evening they COME BACK (shub)' - the nightly return of the prowling enemies; part of the dog-refrain. Standalone.
v6: 'HOWLING (hamah) like dogs' - the enemies imaged as snarling scavenger dogs; part of the dog-refrain (v6,14). Standalone (image).
v6: 'howling like DOGS (keleb)' - the scavenger-dog image for the prowling enemies; the refrain's central figure. Standalone (image).
go around / prowl (sabab - prowling about the city)
v6: 'PROWLING (sabab) about the city' - the dogs circling the city walls; part of the dog-refrain. Standalone (image).
gush / bellow (naba - bellowing with their mouths)
v7: 'bellowing (naba) with their mouths' - the enemies spewing forth vile speech; the arrogance behind it is the char (280640), here the image of gushing speech. Standalone (image of speech).
v7: 'with SWORDS (chereb) in their lips' - the words-as-weapons image (cf Ps57:4); the enemies' harmful speech pictured as blades. Standalone (image).
v7: 'swords in their LIPS (saphah)' - the lips as the site of the weaponised speech; part of the swords-in-lips image. Standalone (image).
lips (saphah - the words of their lips)
v12: 'the words of their LIPS (saphah)' - the lips as the seat of the enemies' sinful speech; the sin itself is the char (280548). Standalone (the lips).
be caught / trapped (lakad - let them be trapped in their pride)
v12: 'let them be TRAPPED (lakad) in their pride' - the wished ensnaring of the enemies by their own arrogance; the pride is the char (280553), here the being-caught. Standalone (wished entrapment).
tell / utter (saphar - the cursing and lies they utter)
v12: 'the cursing and lies that they UTTER (saphar)' - the act of speaking; its content, cursing and lies, is the char (280555,280556). Standalone (the uttering).
return / come back (shub - each evening they come back)
v14: 'Each evening they COME BACK (shub)' - the refrain of the prowling enemies repeated; part of the dog-refrain. Standalone (refrain repeat).
v14: 'HOWLING (hamah) like dogs' - the dog-refrain repeated; part of the recurring scavenger image. Standalone (refrain repeat).
v14: 'like DOGS (keleb)' - the dog-image repeated in the refrain; the enemies as scavengers. Standalone (refrain repeat).
v14: 'PROWLING (sabab) about the city' - the dogs circling the city, refrain repeated. Standalone (refrain repeat).
wander (nua - they wander about for food)
v15: 'They WANDER (nua) about for food' - the scavenger dogs roaming for scraps, imaging the enemies' hungry restlessness. Standalone (image).
food / eat (akal - wander about for food)
v15: 'wander about for FOOD (akal)' - the scraps the dog-enemies seek; part of the scavenger image. Standalone (image).
growl / spend the night (lin - growl if not filled)
v15: 'and GROWL (lin) if they do not get their fill' - the dogs snarling in unsatisfied hunger; part of the scavenger image of the enemies. Standalone (image).
be satisfied / filled (saba - if they do not get their fill)
v15: 'if they do not get their FILL (saba)' - the dogs' unsatisfied hunger; part of the scavenger image, the enemies' restless craving. Standalone (image).
distress / trouble (tsar - the day of my distress)
v16: 'a refuge in the day of my DISTRESS (tsar)' - the trouble from which God sheltered him; the external straits, the occasion of the refuge. Standalone (the distress).
